description: A low-cost self-guided CPR training system developed by Yibo Meng and colleagues that combines a sensor-equipped mannequin, electrotactile and visual performance feedback, and a Tibetan-language narrative game.
title: TibetCPR

description: A three-level framework for structuring and assessing thoracic-ultrasound competence and progression in respiratory and acute-medicine trainees, based on EFSUMB and Royal College of Radiologists guidance.
title: Tiered levels of ultrasound competence (EFSUMB three-tier hierarchy and proposed TUS-specific gradations)

description: A program providing infant and early childhood mental health consultation to build consultees' capacity to support young children's mental health, implemented through the Center of Excellence framework.
title: TIKES program

description: A Louisiana statewide infant and early childhood mental health consultation programme that provides regular mental-health-professional visits, classroom and child consultation, caregiver support, and professional development to early-education sites.
title: TIKES statewide IECMHC program (Louisiana)

description: A bilingual Spanish–Guaraní preschool mathematics curriculum adapted from Big Math for Little Kids and delivered through interactive audio lessons with songs, stories, movement, games, teacher training, and in-class tutoring.
title: Tikichuela: Mathematics in My School

description: A mobile augmented-reality app developed by Heather Toomey Zimmerman and colleagues for family, place-based learning about Appalachian geological history.
title: Time Explorers

description: A study-administered assessment battery combining a TIMSS-derived mathematics proficiency test with the 100-item Mental Health Test (MHT) for measuring rural primary students’ mathematics performance and anxiety risk.
title: TIMSS-derived mathematics test and Mental Health Test (MHT) battery

description: TinkerPlots is dynamic statistical software for educational data analysis, visualization, and probability modeling, produced by its developers for learners from secondary school through university.
title: TinkerPlots

description: Tips by Text is a school-delivered text-message programme that gives parents of young children weekly information, home-activity suggestions, and developmental encouragement to support language, literacy, numeracy, and socioemotional learning.
title: Tips by Text
Title VII grant and contract program for research on new educational media under the National Defense Education Act
